correctness.rationale: Both least periods and the displayed histograms are correct. Integer recurrence and A^8=I+3B give six unit-lifting progressions per sequence, twice per residue class modulo 3, and force a least period of 8·3^(k−1) by the mod-3 state cycle and regular-branch injectivity. In each remaining branch the other coordinate divided by 3 runs bijectively modulo 3^(k−1). The norm identity and the sign modulo 3 choose the right square root. For U(z)=sqrt(1+λz²) with λ in 9Z_3, rationalizing U(z)−U(z′) shows it is divisible by 9(z−z′); the denominators 1+U and the sum of the two outer square roots are units. Thus the normalizing map is the identity plus a 9-contraction and permutes each finite quotient. The two critical classes are disjoint. Modulo 3^h an output of valuation 2j has two simple unit roots lifted with 3^j free choices, and zero has 3^floor(h/2) roots; every root gives three branch preimages. The cases k=1 and k=2, the zero square class and the half-Pell–Lucas normalization all agree. Independent norm-algebra enumeration from k=1 to 11 matched both complete histograms, the predicted square counts and least periods (1,417,168 scalar evaluations). Replay: python3 /workspace/branches/reproduce_frozen.py pell; log /workspace/branches/reproduction-pell.txt. This finite check does not prove unrestricted k.

evidence: Equation (4.1) and the following invariant argument say that all states with invariant ±1 constitute the single Pell orbit. At first coordinate a the fiber is therefore #roots(b−a)²=2a²−1 plus #roots(b−a)²=2a²+1, modulo 3^k; the two conditions are disjoint.

For a≡0 mod 3 exactly one radicand is a unit square and the other is nonsquare. For a≡±1 the first radicand has exactly two roots and the second lies in 3Z/3^k. On either fixed unit class a↦2a²+1 bijects to 3Z/3^k, since its derivative 4a is a unit. The second root count is zero unless the radicand is a square, and for k≥2 the only such radicands are 9 times squares modulo 3^(k−2); each reduced root has three lifts. Counting even-valuation squares and zero gives precisely the frozen multiplicity list. For k=1 the second radicand is zero and supplies one extra preimage on each unit class.

evidence: The seed-state invariant for q=2 is a²+2ab−b²=2a²−(b−a)²; V_n(2,−1)=2Q_n, so normalization by 2 only permutes labels.

The Pell seed has invariant −1 and the associated Pell seed has invariant 2. Choose a unit s with s²=−2 modulo 3^k (simple roots modulo 3). By the published decomposition, the entire associated Pell state orbit is s times the Pell orbit, hence the histograms coincide by a scalar relabeling.
